evidence.min_years: Experience: 2+ years in BI, analytics, or data roles
evidence.seniority: Experience: 2+ years in BI, analytics, or data roles
evidence.domain: preferably in a retail or data-rich environment
must_have_skills: Advanced SQL skills; hands-on experience with BigQuery or a similar cloud data warehouse (Snowflake/Redshift).
Proven experience building BI dashboards in Tableau, MicroStrategy, or other modern BI tools.
Solid understanding of dimensional modeling (star/snowflake), metric definitions, and performance tuning.
Knowledge of data quality processes, governance frameworks, and access management.
nice_to_have_skills: Python/R for analysis, automation, or data validation.
Familiarity with dbt/Dataform, Fivetran (or similar ELT tools), and Git/CI for BI content version control.
Basic statistics and experimentation design (A/B testing).
